Community Solutions for Two Sum

One-pass Hash Table (Python / Java / C++)

By using an inverted index (hash map), we can check for complements in O(1) time complexity.

def twoSum(nums, target):
    prevMap = {}
    for i, n in enumerate(nums):
        diff = target - n
        if diff in prevMap:
            return [prevMap[diff], i]
        prevMap[n] = i
